description: Return when the named PE service answers healthy on its status API, or fail after the timeout (default 60 seconds) with a report of what was awaited, the last HTTP result, failed pe-* units and the redacted service log tail

service.description: What service to check. For example: all, pe-master, orchestrator-service

port.description: Which port to query the status API on

timeout.description: Seconds to keep waiting before failing. Defaults to 60.

interval.description: Seconds to sleep between attempts. Defaults to 3.
